instruction: I want Vim to automatically enable auto-indentation when I edit files. Please search the Internet for instructions on enabling auto-indent in Vim and set it as the default configuration for my local Vim.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_autoindent__9d92a3a9.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set autoindent" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "set ai" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Auto-Indent Is Enabled!"
else
    echo "Auto-indent not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_autoindent__9d92a3a9.sh
